question.name: The Mask That Wouldn't Stay Hidden
question.text: An old mask keeps appearing in unexpected places, although every villager denies moving it.

choices.label: Hold a ceremony to return it to a safe place.

a1.text: A curious animal has been dragging it around. The children name the creature the Mask Keeper.

a2.text: A child confesses to moving it as part of a game and apologizes.

a3.text: Wind through a hollow opening makes the mask whistle eerily.

b1.text: The ceremony brings the village together.

b2.text: The mask slips off its stand and lands on the officiant's head. Everyone laughs, including the officiant.

b3.text: A storyteller invents an elaborate legend that becomes a favorite bedtime tale.
